objective: Test whether the exact settled funding cash transfer creates a causal payer-side liquidity release or a completed-sweep reversal large enough to survive realistic cost stress before any official 2024 opening.

smc_ict_translation.liquidity_pool: The mechanically vulnerable side is defined by the final settled funding debit, extreme aligned premium and fit-only crowding thresholds rather than a hindsight swing.
smc_ict_translation.displacement: A completed post-settlement bar moves in the payer-flush direction or produces a completed extension-and-reclaim against that direction.
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_run: Deferred payer reduction or a prepaid extension through the prior extreme is the objective sweep event.
smc_ict_translation.execution_if_survivor: Only the first causal retracement into the displacement imbalance may become the exact-execution entry; the fatal screen uses a deliberately conservative later next-open proxy.
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: Failure of the settlement-derived state, completed reclaim against the intended direction, or premium-anchor non-contraction invalidates the corresponding family.

information_contract.funding_availability: The final settled rate becomes usable only at the exact timestamp returned by Bybit.
information_contract.bar_availability: Pre-state uses bars completed strictly before settlement. Post-state uses one or two fully completed five-minute bars.
information_contract.entry_delay: One additional full five-minute boundary after confirmation: T+10m for one confirmation bar and T+15m for two.
information_contract.global_slot: One pending/open position across all four symbols; simultaneous candidates are ranked by frozen normalized state score and deterministic symbol order.

families.deferred_payer_flush: Extreme settled funding plus aligned premium, limited prepaid move and completed payer-direction impulse; trade the payer-flush direction.
families.prepaid_sweep_reversal: Extreme settled funding after a large prepaid payer-direction move, followed by completed extension through the prior extreme and at least half-range reclaim; trade against the payer-flush direction.
families.premium_anchor_snapback: Extreme settled funding and aligned premium followed by a frozen fractional absolute-premium contraction; trade toward the index anchor.

interpretation_boundary.if_zero_survivors: Retire this exact funding-transfer dependency and change source or payoff without adjacent threshold tuning.
interpretation_boundary.if_survivor: Keep 2024 sealed and reconstruct exact BBO/depth, first-imbalance-retracement entry, hold-period funding, state-transition exits, risk sizing and continuous NAV on remaining pre-2024 data.

prohibitions: No final funding rate before the exact returned settlement timestamp.
No assumed fixed UTC settlement clock as a trigger.
No same-confirmation-boundary or favorable OHLC fill.
No parameter, family, threshold, cost, gate or fallback change after development outcomes.
No cumulative-ranking promotion from the proxy fatal screen.
